svg.title: Multipath channel and linear equalisation
svg.desc: Four panels show the two-tap impulse response, channel and inverse-filter magnitude responses, and BPSK samples without and with noise.

cc:Work.dc:title: Multipath channel and linear equalisation
cc:Work.dc:description: Two-tap channel, magnitude response and BPSK samples before and after recursive equalisation.
